title: Site configuration
description: What every page and the feed say about the site as a whole.

title.title: Title
title.description: The site's name, at the top of every page and as the feed's title.

url.title: Address
url.description: The absolute http or https address the site is published at. The feed's links are made from it.

description.title: Description
description.description: One or two sentences about the site, beneath the index's heading and as the feed's subtitle. Leaving it out writes neither.

author.title: Author
author.description: Who writes the site, named in every page's footer and as the feed's author.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language the site is written in, as a BCP 47 tag such as en or fr-CA. It is en when left out.
